Whether in building and engineering, road and civil engineering, bridge and tunnel construction, building materials production, project development or building management - we are thinking ahead to become the most innovative and sustainable construction technology group in Europe. Equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion are integral parts of what makes us a company and how we work.
Together we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow in new tasks. Together we create great things. Let's make progress!

Planning: in Werkhof 80 - 100% location Rothenburg (LU)
Your contribution with us

• Planning and provision of special underground construction equipment (e.g. drilling equipment, rams, injection systems) for the construction sites in cooperation with the group management

• Planning and coordination of transports, materials and equipment deployments across several construction sites

• Coordination with construction management and polishing on needs, dates and availability

• Monitoring the equipment inventory as well as coordination of maintenance, repair and testing with the workshop

• Ensuring the readiness of all devices at the right time and place

• Co-responsibility for compliance with costs and budgetary requirements in the scheduling

• Ensuring occupational safety and compliance with environmental requirements
What matters to us

• Several years of professional experience in the dispatch, workshop or machinery park of a construction company

• Completed training preferably in the field of construction machinery, mechanical engineering, logistics or construction management with corresponding further development

• In-depth knowledge of special foundation construction equipment and methods (drilling piles, anchors, sheet piling, injections or the like) is advantageous

• Good technical understanding and affinity for construction machinery

• Safe handling of the PC and the common software tools

• Team orientation and communication strength

• Organizational talent, assertiveness and a structured working method

Our added value for you
With us you can expect a strong team that stands up for each other, on the construction site and in the workshop. Common occasions, where the grill sometimes runs hot, are just as much a part of this as training and space to grow professionally. You work with modern equipment in a well-equipped environment and take on a role in which you can really make a difference.
